QuestInfo.name: The Glowing Charms
QuestInfo.0: There is a second note on the #b#p617##k in #m10005070#.
QuestInfo.1: Brin's note says the charms that #o21#s carry glow brighter near the giant mushroom. I need to collect #b30 #t4000020#s#k from #r#o21#s#k and bring them to the #b#p617##k.
QuestInfo.2: I lined up the #t4000020#s by the board. The brightest ones came from the deepest part of the tunnel.

0.0: (The second note is in different handwriting.)
0.1: "Day 3. The #o21#s carry little charms. Look closely: they glow, and they glow brighter the deeper we go. I think they point to the giant mushroom. - Brin"
0.2: (If you collect enough charms, maybe you can see where they point. Will you collect #b30 #t4000020#s#k from #r#o21#s#k?)

yes.0: (You decide to collect #b30 #t4000020#s#k. The #r#o21#s#k live all through the Ant Tunnel.)

1.0: (You lay the #t4000020#s out by the board. The brightest ones all came from the deepest part of the tunnel.)
1.1: (Behind the charms, one more note is pinned to the board. It looks like it was written in a hurry.)

item.0: (You don't have enough charms yet. Collect #b30 #t4000020#s#k from #r#o21#s#k.)
